title: Trump Tells APEC the US Rejects Global AI Regulation
dek: Speaking in Shenzhen, he still admitted AI has risks that need careful handling.
caption:
Trump went to China and told world leaders: no global rules for AI. 🌏

At the APEC summit in Shenzhen, President Donald Trump said the US opposes any "globalist regulation" meant to control or slow AI, calling it the biggest shift since the Industrial Revolution. He also admitted superintelligence has some bad sides that need careful handling, but gave no details and announced no new policy.

The timing is pointed: days earlier, Xi Jinping urged deeper international cooperation on AI. Meanwhile, Washington keeps tightening Nvidia-era AI chip export controls. The split means businesses should plan for different AI rules in different regions, not one global standard.

We're following the Trump, Xi and Putin meeting at AI Parabellum for any sign of a joint deal on AI safety.

post_caption:
Shared rules or national control? The US just picked a side on AI governance.

Trump's APEC speech drew a hard line against international AI rules, right after Xi called for closer cooperation. Expect US AI policy to keep coming from Washington agencies and states like California, not a treaty.
